item.name: 100G Powerful Viscosity Mud Iron Clay Adhesive Foundry Glue For Metal Wood Glass Stone Repair Paste
item.title: 100G Powerful Viscosity Mud Iron Clay Adhesive Foundry Glue For Metal Wood Glass Stone Repair Paste
item.description:
💯Description:
Name: Strong mud iron glue metal paste
Content: 100g
Color: Black/White/Grey
Use ratio: A:B=1:1 (mixed use)
Curing time: 1 hour for initial solidification, 24 hours for full solidification
Chemical compressive strength: 82~95 (Mpa)
Density: 1.6~1.85H/CM2
Temperature resistance range: -45℃~200℃
💯temperature resistance range: mainly used for repairing various casting defects such as sand holes, pores and cracks in steel, iron, aluminum and other castings
💯Package Included:1*metal welding glue+sandpaper+disposable gloves

How to use:
① Keep the surface of the substrate clean, dust-free, dry, water-free, and oil-free to ensure good bonding and sealing effects;
② Mix the AB components in equal amounts in a 1:1 ratio and mix them thoroughly (otherwise they will not solidify). The mixed glue should be used up within 30 minutes;
③ Fill the mixed glue evenly on the surface of the substrate and apply slight pressure to enhance the bonding effect. You can use a knife to trim and shape it before it is completely solidified;
④ Keep it dry and wait for solidification. Under the conditions of temperature (23±2)℃ and relative humidity (50±5)%, the surface drying time is about 1 hour, and the complete solidification time is about 24 hours.

Specifications:

1: Instead of welding, it is stronger than iron, and solves the drawbacks of ordinary glue that cannot be processed

2: High resistance! Low temperature, no fear of temperature difference changes, to meet various requirements of water tanks, fuel tanks, engines, etc.

3: The glue is tested at high temperature. After the glue is cured, it is placed in water and boiled in a pot. The glue still has no degumming and melting reaction.

4: Drilling, washing and grinding test. After the glue is cured, use an electric drill, sharpener, and grinding to test. The glue has toughness and is still bright and beautiful without damage.

5: Metal fittings welding scene, as long as metal fittings can be welded, suitable for various electrical appliances, machines, etc.

💯Feedback：
Please kindly leave us a positive feedback (5 stars) , if you are satisfied with our items.
